name: Semarang
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -6 to -9 spatial average across coastal zones; -10 to -19 in northern hotspots (5 to >10 cm/yr in Arimoto et al. 2011; 10-12 cm/yr north/east in Aditiya & Ito 2023)
literature_sources: Abidin, H.Z. et al. (2013), Natural Hazards 66, coastal land subsidence in Semarang
Bott, L.M. et al. (2021), Land subsidence and tidal flooding in Semarang
Aditiya, A. & Ito, T. (2023), Int. J. Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation, https://doaj.org/article/bc659cefcb624b38a67982d1
agreement_note: UPDATED AFTER QC REPROCESS: Initial -12.1 cm upland spike caused by a 29 Sep -> 11 Oct phase-cycle jump (-11.18 cm) was removed. Reprocessed 7-pair chain (2026-06-25 to 2026-09-29, 96 days) places peak on the northern coast at -6.2 cm LOS (-8.1 cm vertical est., -6.5 cm/100d), consistent with northern Semarang's published 10-19 cm/yr rates.
press_summary_gate_note: Reprocessed after QC phase-cycle removal (-6.2 cm LOS / -6.5 cm/100d, northern coast); rank #5 reliable in ATLAS v2, pending PC5 final sign-off.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
